results: 1. blood glucose: normal glucose and electrolytes - excludes hyperglycaemic chorea
2. TSH, free T4 and free T3: TSH SUPPRESSED at <0.01 mIU/L (reference 0.50-5.00) and free thyroxine ELEVATED at 3.85 ng/dL (reference 0.90-1.70)
3. thyrotropin receptor antibodies (TRAb): ELEVATED at 7.4 IU/L (reference <2.0) - Graves' disease
4. thyroid ultrasound: no nodules; estimated thyroid weight 13 g; 99mTc scintigraphy showed diffuse uptake consistent with Graves' disease
5. trial of antithyroid treatment: methimazole; the chorea resolved after about one month as thyroid function improved
